# Suniket

Suniket is a Czech hard rock band from Týnec nad Sázavou, formed in 2024. The band performs original hard rock-heavy music and gigs across the Czech Republic.

## Members
- Victor Hrazdil – vocals
- Lukáš Janata – guitar
- Marek Dudkovič – guitar, manager
- Dominik Hrazdil – bass
- Kryštof Doležel – drums
